name: ChooseCard
description: Choose cards are large radio buttons: each option is a card with a name, a description and an optional price, and people pick exactly one. Use them when options need explaining, such as plans.
whenToUse: To pick one of two to four options that each need a sentence of explanation, e.g. a plan or a delivery speed.
When the choice is important enough to deserve visual weight.

whenNotToUse.text: For short options that need no explanation.
For more than about five options.
When several options can be chosen.

anatomy.name: Card
anatomy.description: The whole card is the radio button; its border shows the state.

anatomy.name: Price
anatomy.description: Price or other key figure, at the end.

values.meaning: Cards stacked. Default; best in narrow spaces.
Cards in a row that wraps when narrow; for side-by-side comparison.

states.name: Selected
states.meaning: Thicker brand border and a filled indicator.

behavior.text: The group is one Tab stop. Arrow keys move to and select the next or previous card.
Nothing is selected until the person chooses, unless you set value or defaultValue. Preselect only a safe, sensible default.
Horizontal groups wrap onto more rows when there isn’t room; the selected border grows inward so nothing shifts.
The indicator moves to the right and the price to the left.

content: Title: the option’s name in one or two words.
Description: one line on what the option gives, focused on the difference from the others.
Price: include the period, e.g. “$29 / month”.

guidelines.do: Name the group with a visible heading via aria-labelledby.
guidelines.why: Screen reader users hear the group name before the options.

guidelines.do: Keep descriptions parallel and about the same length.
guidelines.dont: Write a paragraph on one card and a word on the next.
guidelines.why: Parallel content makes options easy to compare.
Large cards for many options push the rest of the page away; use a RadioGroup.

keyboard.action: Moves into the group, to the selected card (or the first).
Move to and select the next or previous card.

aria.when: Always: point it at the visible heading (or use aria-label).
Set automatically: the title names it; description and price describe it.

accessibility.focus: A focus ring surrounds the focused card.

wcag.how: Radio group semantics expose the single-choice relationship.
Selection shows as a filled indicator and a thicker border, not only color.
Tab and arrow keys operate the group.

examples.title: Plan picker
examples.description: Three plans side by side, labelled by a heading.
examples.code:
import { ChooseCardGroup, ChooseCard } from '@ds/react';

Choose your plan

examples.title: Controlled
Unavailable option
examples.description: Disable an option and say why.
examples.code:
import { ChooseCardGroup, ChooseCard } from '@ds/react';

<ChooseCardGroup aria-label="Data refresh">
  <ChooseCard value="daily" title="Daily" description="Once a day" />
  <ChooseCard value="realtime" title="Real-time" description="Available on Pro" disabled />
</ChooseCardGroup>

related.relation: For cards that link somewhere instead of selecting.

changes: Rebuilt as ChooseCardGroup + ChooseCard on a real radio group: one Tab stop, arrow keys, named options.
isSelected/onChange replaced by value/onValueChange on the group.
New tokens for hover, selected, indicator, focus and per-mode corners.
Softer borders: a 1 px field-gray border, 2 px accent when selected.
Horizontal groups share the row equally and wrap text; a card moves to a new row only below its minimum width.

components.name: ChooseCardGroup
components.description:
A set of large, card-style options where exactly one can be chosen, e.g. a plan. Arrow
keys move between cards; the group is a single Tab stop.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value when the selection changes.

orientation.description: `vertical` (default) stacks cards; `horizontal` puts them in a row that wraps when narrow.

aria-labelledby.description:
Name the group with aria-labelledby (pointing at a visible heading) or aria-label,
e.g. "Plan".

aria-label.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

components.name: ChooseCard
components.description: One option inside a ChooseCardGroup. The whole card is the radio button.

title.description: Option name, e.g. "Pro plan". Names the radio.

description.description: What the option includes. Read after the name.

price.description: Price or other key figure, shown at the end, e.g. "$12 / month".
